rows.what_the_ink_shows: In crops/6_scan013_L699_relative_base.jpg the line reads “Modules cohérents [struck stratifiés] sur X_K, stratifiés relativement à X_K.” Both occurrences have a full-size X with two crossing diagonal strokes and a separate capital K lowered to its right as a subscript. The second X is clear, uncancelled and not an insertion mark; it is not merely K. The strikeout is over the earlier word stratifiés, before sur, and does not extend to the relative-base expression. In crops/6_scan013_L699_field_context.jpg the next context separately says “comme ici K est de caractéristique nulle” and has the inserted words “et X_K lisse dessus”. The relative-base expression in the original LaTeX matches the visible X_K.
rows.note: Preserve “stratifiés relativement à X_K” as a clear author/typescript slip. The supplied sweep-3 SA15 row proposes “relativement à K”, explaining that the relevant base is the field K, and reports agreement with Michel Hua’s project. This is an intended mathematical correction; the observed second X_K has not been cancelled or replaced in the scan. No exception to a contrary ink reading is involved: the row itself records the written X_K. The mathematical argument and the reference to 1.8 are carried only as attributed table background. Both crops use Pillow LANCZOS enlargement to 2800 pixels across and contrast factor 1.6.
